runs.outcome: Entry kill gate UNMET and preserved rather than repaired. Pooled exterior R2 0.49527 against the pre-registered starter-kit bar of 0.94, over 20 shots and 4,140 frames; per-shot median 0.238, max 0.832, min -2.53. Critically this is NOT an amplitude or units error: the post-hoc best scale is 0.338 yet the scale-invariant correlation R2 is only 0.407, so the predicted vacuum field has the wrong shape, not merely the wrong magnitude. Two candidate causes are named and neither was tuned against: the starter README describes FITTING psi outside the plasma envelope to Green functions and still references coil_turns, while the shipped dataset has no coil_turns field, declares F currents already in kA.turn, leaves ECOILA turns unresolved over 1..96 and ships no bcoil poloidal geometry - so the published bar may score a fitted exterior decomposition rather than the absolute current-only forward our doctrine requires; and the ohmic set may be structurally incomplete with no ECOILB representation, which would produce exactly this shape deficit. The gate harness, geometry registry and preregistration receipt are sound and banked.
